thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> P1 triggered: INC-2026-2746. Service: ratecap-service (us-west-2). Alert: sudden surge of 429s flagged by quota-anomaly detector. Link: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026-2746 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident auto-page sent to eng-sre, eng-runtime. Escalation step 1: sam_g

sam_g: Acked. I'm on it. Starting with traffic and limiter leader check. pinging dashboards and logs.

alicia_ops: Seeing ~4.7% 429s across read/write endpoints. Top affected customers: tenant-alpha, tenant-beta, synthetic-tests. No config changes in prod in last 2 hours per config-service.

sam_g: Running `kubectl get pods -n ratecap -o wide` now. Also hitting the limiter metrics at /metrics — there are long GC pauses on limiter-0 replica.

nora_eng: I can repro a small local spike when quota-mapper returns a 500 for some keys. Could be fallback path mapping everything to a default strict quota.

eng-runtime-rot: FYI we had a canary of quota-mapper v2 pushed ~45m ago to us-west. Telemetry looked green but maybe rollover failed.

sam_g: If quota-mapper returns error, ratecap falls back to global enforcement. Check mapping logs: `kubectl logs quota-mapper-*/`

alicia_ops: Logs show repeated `Err: upstream timeout` and then `mapped_quota: default: 10r/s` for many tenant keys. That explains the 429s.

sam_g: Mitigation plan: 1) Disable quota-mapper v2 canary (route all traffic to v1) 2) Roll limiter-0 restart to clear GC stall 3) Increase burst window temporarily for impacted routes 4) Notify customers. Executing step 1 now.

sam_g: `kubectl patch svc quota-mapper -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"false"}}}'` — canary removed, traffic supposed to shift to v1.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-2746 acknowledged by sam_g at 2026-03-14T02:15:01Z

alicia_ops: After routing to v1, 429 rate dropped to ~0.8% within 90s. Still seeing some residual 429s from tenant-beta.

nora_eng: Investigating quota-mapper v2 telemetry. Looks like a connection pool exhaustion to config-store under heavy fanout. Need fix in mapping client.

eng-runtime-rot: I restarted limiter-0 (graceful) to clear GC. Post-restart latency normalized.

sam_g: Applying temporary increase: `config change: ratecap.default_burst=5x` for 10m window. Pushing now.

alicia_ops: Confirmed burst update propagated. Error rate down to 0.2% and steady. No new PD pages.

kate_pm: Customer impact: Estimated 0.5% of traffic hit 429s for ~12 minutes. Affected SLAs: interactive-chat (minor), batch-embeddings (some retries). No data loss. Preparing a short incident summary for affected customers.

nora_eng: Root cause summary draft: quota-mapper v2 canary had connection pooling bug leading to intermittent 5xxs; ratecap fell back to default strict quotas causing elevated 429s.

sam_g: Postmortem actions: 1) Revert quota-mapper v2 until fix 2) Add circuit-breaker on quota-mapper client to prevent global fallback 3) Increase observability: per-tenant mapping failure rates 4) Run capacity test on config-store.

eng-runtime-rot: Created ticket RNW-4567 for client fix, RNW-4568 for circuit-breaker, RNW-4569 for runbook updates.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-2746 resolved by sam_g at 2026-03-14T02:46:40Z

sam_g: Marking incident as resolved. Handoff to daytime oncall @kate_pm for customer comms and tracked follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

kate_pm: Acknowledged handoff. I'll draft the customer note and assign follow-ups.

alicia_ops: Adding logs and zip to the incident folder: s3://incidents/2026/INC-2026-2746/logs.zip

sam_g: Final note: short outage window ~12m, root cause is quota-mapper v2 rollout -> do not re-rollout until RNW-4567 fixed.

kate_pm: Closing slack thread; will update once postmortem is ready.
